theme: Hybrid Platform (Light Mode for Passenger, Dark Mode for Driver)

headings.usage: Use for primary numbers (earnings), H1, H2. Must use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Use for all UI text, labels, and bottom sheet content.

layout.global_container: max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] relative overflow-hidden bg-background sm:shadow-2xl sm:ring-1 sm:ring-border/50 sm:rounded-[2.5rem] sm:my-8
layout.map_layer: absolute inset-0 z-0 w-full h-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900

bottom_sheet.container: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-surface rounded-t-[2rem] shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] p-6 pt-4 pb-8
bottom_sheet.drag_handle: w-12 h-1.5 bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700 rounded-full mx-auto mb-6

buttons.primary: w-full rounded-2xl h-14 font-semibold text-lg transition-transform active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: w-full rounded-2xl h-14 font-medium text-base bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-primary_text transition-transform active:scale-95

inputs.text: bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 border-0 h-14 rounded-2xl px-4 text-base focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent w-full

cards.earnings_widget: rounded-3xl bg-surface p-5 border border-border flex flex-col justify-between

components.role_selector: flex flex-col gap-4 p-8 w-full h-full justify-center items-center bg-zinc-950 text-white

interactions.sheet_transition: Use framer-motion for bottom sheet Y-axis sliding. Spring physics: stiffness 300, damping 30.
interactions.hover_states: Since this simulates mobile, focus on active:scale-95 for touch feedback rather than complex hovers.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='role-passenger-btn', data-testid='request-ride-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. MOBILE VIEWPORT SIMULATION: Since the stack is React.js/Tailwind, simulate a mobile app by wrapping the main Router/App in a div with `max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] sm:rounded-[2.5rem] overflow-hidden relative shadow-2xl`. Do not build a standard desktop web layout.
2. THEME SPLIT: The Role Selector screen should set a global state (Passenger vs Driver). If Driver is selected, apply the `dark` class to the wrapper. If Passenger, ensure it is removed.

3. MAP IMPLEMENTATION: The map must sit at `absolute inset-0 z-0`. Use react-map-gl, leaflet, or a mocked interactive div if no keys are present. All app UI (search bars, ride options) should float over it in absolute positioned Bottom Sheets.
4. BOTTOM SHEETS: Do not use Shadcn Dialog for the main map UI. Build a custom absolutely positioned div anchored to the bottom with `rounded-t-[2rem]` to act as a persistent or sliding sheet.
5. DRIVER DASHBOARD: Use 'Bento Grid' strategy. A large toggle for Online/Offline, and compact square widgets (`aspect-square`) for Earnings ($124.50) and Acceptance Rate.
6. ICONS: Extensively use `lucide-react` for UI elements (Car, MapPin, Navigation, Star, Wallet, User).

7. AVOID: Do not use generic standard Shadcn cards with small borders for the mobile feel. Use generous border radii (`rounded-2xl`, `rounded-3xl`) and large hit areas (h-14 buttons) for touch targets.
